Message:
As I walked down the hall,
a girl I’d never seen before
called out to me.

I felt a strange presence
radiating from her body,
and quickly unsheathed my sword.
But, the girl only
giggled in response.

“There’s no need to
be so on guard,
wielder of the holy sword.
I’m a witch of this mansion
as well, you know.”

The girl who
called herself “Theresa”
then flashed me a smile.

As if some kind of pressure
had been placed on my body,
I took a step back.

Even though I was still
holding up my sword,
instead of showing anger,
or even fear...

“Yes, of course.
I know all about
that sword, you...

My heart felt like it would stop.
How...does she know that name...?

...Of course I do!
She’s the one who betrayed us,
she abandoned our mission,
and she’s the reason
the Hero of the Staff...!

But...for some reason,
those words refused to
leave my lips.

Hehe... I know, Theresa...
My apologies.
It appears there is
something urgent
I must attend to.”

Leaving me with those words,
all I could do was watch
as she walked away...
